verification.validation: Go datamigrate tests with -race, including 8 concurrent processes and 16 goroutines; the frontend ts gate (vue-tsc typecheck, the full vitest run, build, consumer test and pack) on Linux; the node-dist release test; plus generated package metadata, executor manifest and content checks.

changes: AppShell offers Sign out on the entry page that ui.launch: new-page opens, a portal alias and a short path (host standalone-web with dsmStandalone true), as it already did in a DSM window. A page outside DSM and a native shell show the account without it.

The entry host's sign-out ends the DSM session and reopens the page's address signed out, so each entry takes its own sign-in and keeps the App's route, instead of leaving the user on DSM's desktop. AppContextOptions.navigate overrides where it goes.

datamigrate: a run with work to do takes an exclusive flock on .data-version.lock in the data directory and reads the state again under it, so concurrent CGI requests, the daemon and lifecycle scripts apply each migration once. The wait has no time limit; the new RunContext ends it on cancellation and stops before the next migration. An up-to-date run takes no lock.
Reuse the existing executor release and digests.
